incident_symptoms: Rebuilding image after trivial source code or comment edit triggers full dependency reinstall, leading to prolonged build times
Sensitive configuration files and extraneous workspace directories (.env, .git) are leaking into the Docker image layers

root_causes.defect_1_cache_invalidation: Inversion of Dockerfile instructions where 'COPY . .' was placed prior to 'RUN npm install' / 'RUN npm ci'. Docker uses cryptographic layer hashing; modifying any file in the build context invalidates the COPY layer and all downstream layers, destroying cache reuse for the expensive dependency installation step.
root_causes.defect_2_context_leakage: Missing, deleted, or unreferenced .dockerignore file. Without .dockerignore, Docker CLI tarballs the entire workspace including '.env' (secrets and credentials), '.git' (full version control commit history), and local 'node_modules' into the build context, increasing upload size and leaking sensitive secrets into image layers.

remediation_plan: Enforce proper instruction layering: COPY package*.json ./ first, execute RUN npm ci, and only afterwards COPY application source code.
Restore and enforce .dockerignore to exclude .git, .env, .env.*, node_modules, and test files from the build context.
